text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Exhibition Meet finally
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making time to see us,
Trainer.
We just had to greet you in person before
the race...

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
We heard you've been overseeing our daughter's
training. She kept telling us
how wonderful she's been feeling thanks to
you... Truly, thank you so much.
choice_data_list: Oh, please! I really didn't do any...

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
There's no need for modesty. As you know,
there are many concerns regarding her
running.
Thank you for supporting both her body and
her spirit.
choice_data_list: No... honestly, it wasn't much at ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling utterly humbled,
I bowed repeatedly.
To someone like me who was practically
abandoning their role today,
such sincere gratitude stung.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then,
an announcement echoed through the air
calling the runners together—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it's almost time. Well, Father,
Mother, Doctor.
And Trainer... I should get going.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kei-chan, wait!
Um... please be careful out there.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard, all right?!
Just crossing that finish line safe and
sound is more than enough—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll be okay!
...I'll be fine, Mother, Father.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here at Tracen Academy is
incredible.
I know today's race won't be an easy one.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will win. I'll prove it to you.
—Because I am the fastest of all.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
After all, I have these legs that Mother,
Father,
and the Doctor gave me...
legs I'm so proud of.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: And besides—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have the running form that my trainer
polished together with me,
and that's something I'm proud of too!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, watch me.
Trainer, please watch over me too.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I will win. I swear it.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Because that's the greatest way...
I can ever say "thank you" to everyone.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
the Exhibition Meet 1200m Turf Race began.
The blitz of a sprint reached its final
stretch in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And here comes K.S.Miracle!
K.S.Miracle is making her move!
K.S.Miracle unleashes a massive burst of speed!
Will she take the lead right here?!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah, hah...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet! Don't let up yet! Not yet...
further—!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kh,... AAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Don't let up! Faster! Faster!
Even faster!
Keep pushing! Go—FASTER!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle takes the lead!
K.S.Miracle in front!
With 200 meters to go,
she has broken away completely!!
Out in front is K.S.Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And she crosses the finish line!!
W-What a terrifyingly dominant run by
K.S.Miracle!
A staggering nine lengths over second place!
First place belongs to K.S.Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A thunderous roar of cheers and applause
erupted,
celebrating K.S.Miracle's astonishingly
powerful run.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I did... it......
Yes,... yes...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, even while surrounded by what could
only be described as a wall of sound,
the very first sight she sought out with
her own eyes was—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother! Doctor!
I won... I won! Ahaha...
I did it!! First place!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: I was the fastest... of everyone—!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Um, thank you so much...
Truly, thank you!!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Look. Everyone is... smiling.
I made everyone happy. ...I—!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just so happy...!
...Do you think it reached them?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That I'm okay... and how thankful I am.
Did my feelings... reach them...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at her as perfectly clear tears
spilled down her cheeks,
a thought took hold.
Purely, undeniably—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This girl is alive for this very
purpose."
choice_data_list: (I mean... look at how happy she is.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked happier than in any moment before.
Radiant and brilliantly alive.
Showing proud results to those who saved her,
wearing a smile from the bottom of her
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that is why—

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh no... I got way too carried away.
I need to head back—
choice_data_list: Before that, sit down for a second.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You pushed yourself too hard just ...
You pushed yourself too hard just ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without giving room for argument,
I had her sit down on the spot and sprayed
her legs—which had to be running hot—
with the cooling spray I'd prepared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was still walking on thin ice.
In that race,
she never eased up on her speed
until the very last second.
...Completely disregarding the toll on her
body.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, ...that feels so much better.
It seems I ended up relying on you right to
the very end.
choice_data_list: No. ...What if today isn't the end?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The danger of her pushing herself past her
limits will always be there.
In the future too.
Even so—
if that is where her true happiness lies,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
if I can make her smile like that once
again,
choice_data_list: I want to keep running with you.
I want to keep running with you.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With me...?
Trainer, do you mean—
choice_data_list: I want to become your official tra...
I want to become your official tra...
